title: Mid-Deal Research Request
description: Transaction coordinator requesting additional research after a deal is under contract. Common triggers: inspection findings, appraisal gap, title issues, repair cost estimates.

urgency.description: TC sets this based on which deadline is at risk. Property research must honor it.

context.description: Plain-English description of why the research is needed. E.g. 'Inspection flagged roof replacement needed. Need comps on similar properties post-roof-repair to justify renegotiating price.'

specific_questions.description: Exact questions the research output must answer. Keeps research focused.

deadline_at_risk.description: The key_date from signed_contract_handoff that this research must support.
